description: Located on one of Bret Harte's most desirable streets, this expanded turn-key home offers a level of space and modern comfort rarely seen in the area. Following a comprehensive renovation completed in 2022, this home consists of three bedrooms, three and a half bathrooms and 2,012 square feet. Numerous upgrades include dual pane windows, recessed LED lighting, an upgraded electrical panel and composite decking.  The chef-inspired kitchen is a showstopper, featuring abundant custom cabinetry, sleek quartz countertops, and premium stainless steel appliances from Bosch, Kitchen Aid and Bertazzoni. The expansive breakfast bar serves as a natural gathering point, flowing seamlessly into the dining and family roomsperfect for modern living and effortless entertaining. With a backyard pool and ample deck space which includes an area for dining and lounging, the property fits the Marin County lifestyle. French doors in the family room provide a clear connection to the backyard, completing the seamless indoor-outdoor flow that begins in the kitchen.  Ideally located just around the corner from the local-favorite Bret Harte Park, this residence combines quality craftsmanship with the convenience of a sought-after San Rafael location. Conveniently located a short distance to downtown San Rafael, the property borders Greenbrae and provides easy access to Highway 101 for commuters. This property really does have it all!
